info.title: Gridex Staff API
info.description: Staff accounts and customer service from your own backend. Every staff call requires an API credential and a signed proof of the acting staff login. The platform derives the organization and permissions from those two identities. Every response carries a server-issued X-Request-ID equal to request_id in the body. The optional x-gridex-expected-project-ref header pins the storage project (412 storage_project_mismatch otherwise), and list endpoints accept the opt-in x-gridex-query-parsing: strict profile.

get.summary: List staff accounts with their membership status

parameters.name: x-gridex-staff-assertion
parameters.description: Compact JWT signed by your backend with RS256, PS256 or ES256. iss/aud must equal the configured staff identity provider. sub is the acting staff Gridex user UUID; iat/exp define a lifetime of at most 900 seconds; jti is unique and accepted only once. Active membership and server-calculated permissions are checked for every request.

401.description: API credential or staff assertion missing or invalid.

403.description: Insufficient API scope, staff permission or active organization membership.

404.description: The resource does not exist in this organization.

409.description: Version, membership, role safeguard or idempotency conflict.

412.description: storage_project_mismatch: x-gridex-expected-project-ref is malformed or names another storage project. Nothing was executed; call the deployment that serves the expected project.

422.description: Request fields or business rules are invalid.

500.description: Internal processing failure without private implementation details.

503.description: Required service unavailable; retry only when the error is retryable.

staffAssertion.description: Compact JWT signed by your backend with RS256, PS256 or ES256. iss/aud must equal the configured staff identity provider. sub is the acting staff Gridex user UUID; iat/exp define a lifetime of at most 900 seconds; jti is unique and accepted only once. Active membership and server-calculated permissions are checked for every request.

RequestId.name: x-request-id
RequestId.description: Optional client correlation value (1-128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ".", "_", ":" or "-"). It is recorded separately for support as the client correlation id and never replaces the server request id.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key and unchanged body for a retry. Sign a fresh assertion with a new jti for every attempt.

ExpectedProjectRef.name: x-gridex-expected-project-ref
ExpectedProjectRef.description: Optional 20-character storage project reference you expect to serve this call. A malformed value, or a value that differs from the project served by this deployment, returns 412 storage_project_mismatch before authentication, rate limiting, audit or any write; nothing is executed.

QueryParsing.name: x-gridex-query-parsing
QueryParsing.description: List query parsing profile. compatible (default) keeps the parsing each endpoint has always accepted. strict applies one rule to every Staff list endpoint: each query parameter at most once, and page, page_size and limit only as plain decimal digits without sign, whitespace, exponent, fraction, hexadecimal prefix or leading zero. Violations, and unknown profile values, return 422 invalid_field with error.field naming the parameter, before any data is read.

GridexContractVersion.description: Canonical contract version used for this response.

RequestId.description: Server-issued request id for this call. The same value is returned as request_id in the body (including errors) and recorded in the request log. A client-supplied x-request-id is never echoed here.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for conditional retrieval.

Vary.description: Request headers that affect cache validation.

ProjectRef.description: Storage project reference that served this call. Present when the deployment serves an identified project; compare it with x-gridex-expected-project-ref.

ErrorResponse.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.
